description: This file defines a migration class for version 4.3 of the OrangeHRM software. It contains methods to insert and configure database records related to marketplace addons, permissions, and settings, as well as creating a new database table if it does not exist.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A migration class responsible for updating the database schema and data as part of version 4.3 upgrade, including inserting permissions, configurations, and creating tables.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs database insertions for modules, permissions, and configuration settings, and creates a new table 'ohrm_marketplace_addon' if it doesn't exist.
